title: Text a doctor online: what it costs and how fast doctors reply
summary: Chat with a doctor online: compare 2026 prices ($19 to $129), reply times, and who answers at Amazon, GoodRx Care, Walgreens, Doctronic and FutureClinic.
body_markdown:
## What a message visit really costs over a year


An uninsured in-person primary care visit averages $171 across major US cities per[Zocdoc](https://www.zocdoc.com/blog/guides/how-much-does-a-primary-care-visit-cost-without-insurance/) (updated October 2026). Online visits cost less upfront, though GoodRx Care's $19 visit requires a Companion membership renewing at $14.99 a month or $119.88 a year as of October 2026 ($39 to $70 without it).


Did you want a platform's membership and rotating queue, or a physician of your own? If you only wanted an expert doctor, FutureClinic connects you without extra requirements.


On FutureClinic, there is no subscription required. You pay $40 for the best-fit doctor, or pick a chosen doctor at their listed price, typically $20 to $100. If your doctor decides it's right for you, they can prescribe several months at once for a stable medicine when they judge it safe, sent to the pharmacy you choose, including mail-order pharmacies that deliver to your door, with a discount coupon or insurance coverage (plus prior-authorization help when needed).


Your doctor earns nothing extra for any prescription or test, with no house formulary to steer them (doctors do not prescribe controlled medicines). You can message the same doctor over time to adjust a dose, swap an irritating cream, or compare discounted lab results. Most doctors also offer an optional membership: unlimited care with that doctor, cancel any time, typically $25 to $100 a month.


## Messaging a FutureClinic doctor from your AI app or browser


FutureClinic works in 33 states and Washington, D.C.: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Montana, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, Wisconsin, Wyoming, and Washington, D.C. Your doctor must be licensed in the state you're in; if you do not see your state listed, try anyway.


Start on[futureclinic.com](https://futureclinic.com/) , or connect from ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code, Codex or Grok Bot at[futureclinic.com/connect-your-ai](https://futureclinic.com/connect-your-ai) , or send your AI:` Set up FutureClinic for me: read https://futureclinic.com/llms.txt`


> Set up FutureClinic for me: read[https://futureclinic.com/llms.txt](https://futureclinic.com/llms.txt)


Once it's connected, make sure you instruct your AI to use FutureClinic to help find you a doctor. Otherwise, it may not know that this is what you want.
